name: Clear Transcodes
description: Adds a maintenance task that deletes files from the transcode temp directory once they are older than a configurable number of hours, so abandoned transcodes stop filling up the disk.
overview: Keeps the transcode temp folder from filling up.

versions.changelog: Fixed: the task deleted Jellyfin's own .jellyfin-transcode marker file. Hidden files are now never touched, and a file is only deleted when its extension is on a configurable allow-list. The default maximum file age is 6 hours. Versions 1.0.0.0 and 1.0.1.0 are not offered here because they delete the marker file.
